seen_animation: A boxy van drawn from behind, with a small slanted beacon box on the roof and three or four short ray strokes above it, a double vertical line splitting the rear into two halves and a horizontal belt line across the middle. In frames 1-4 it fills almost the whole frame and is cut off at the bottom. Over frames 5-12 it gets steadily smaller and its lower body comes into view; scribbled oval wheels enter at the bottom edge around frames 7-9 and are fully visible by frame 12. Frames 13-16 continue the slow shrink, the van now complete with both wheels, centred in the frame. Grey scenery: dots of distant lights top right, a grey outline of parked cars on the right edge, and two diagonal ground lines lower left and lower right.
seen_film: A night shot from behind an ambulance driving away from the camera. The rear has two lit windows (figures visible in the right one), a beacon light on the roof, AMBULANCE lettering, two tail lights at the lower corners and, from about frame 9 on, a lit licence plate at the bottom. Through frames 1-16 the ambulance recedes steadily, getting smaller and revealing more of its lower body, staying centred, with parked cars visible along the right edge and the beacon flickering.
named_subject: An ambulance (a van with a roof beacon) seen from behind, driving away.
evidence: Size and placement track the film throughout: e.png 1 and f.png 1 both have the vehicle spanning roughly the full width with the roof near the top and the bottom cropped; at e.png 12 and f.png 12 both are about 80 percent width with the lower body appearing; at e.png 25 and f.png 25 both are about half the frame width with the roof at nearly the same height. g.png shows one steady, evenly spaced shrink with centres moving smoothly upward (1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25) and no gaps or reversals. Wheels enter at e.png 11-12 from the bottom edge as the body rises into frame, consistent with the film's lower body (tail lights, plate) coming into view at f.png 11-16. Only small irregularities: the beacon rays change length between e.png 6-8 (taller in 7-8), which matches the film's flickering beacon rather than reading as a pop. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: The wheels are drawn as tall, narrow scribbled ellipses (e.png 15-25) where the doodle's wheels are round, heavy scribbled circles, so the lower half reads slightly less like c.png than the roof does.
closes_when: In e.png 15-25 the wheels are drawn as round multi-loop scribble circles about as wide as tall, matching c.png, while keeping their positions under the body corners.
protect: The steady, evenly spaced recession matching the film's size and position frame for frame; the roof beacon box with ray strokes; the divider and belt lines; the wheels entering from the bottom edge rather than popping in; the grey parked-car outline and ground lines on the right and left.
identity_gap: The roof beacon, ray strokes, divider and belt lines match c.png, but the wheels are narrower ellipses than the doodle's round scribbled wheels.
